name: Lemony White Bean Dip with Bell Pepper
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a blender. (Alternatively, the dip can be prepared in a food processor.)
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the blender.
Add water, tahini, oil, and spices to the blender. Blend on high for several minutes until smooth. Add more water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach desired consistency. Set aside.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into ¾-inch wide strips.
To serve, divide dip and bell pepper strips between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
